sources.title: Measuring Average Latency with FAISS on Apple M1
sources.snippet: Running the above code on a Mac with an M1 processor, we achieve an impressive average latency of around 7 milliseconds for 1000 searches. This performance demonstrates the efficiency of FAISS and the capabilities of Apple M1 processors for machine learning tasks.
